subject: [PATCH 36/60] mm: refuse explicit reclaim and compaction of private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patches add checks to reject explicit reclaim and compaction requests for private nodes with an error code -EOPNOTSUPP. This is necessary because kswapd and kcompactd do not run on private nodes, but the current implementation allows nodeN/reclaim and nodeN/compact to name a node directly.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series modifies the Linux kernel to prevent explicit reclaim and compaction of private nodes. Private nodes are memoryless, and the current implementation allows requests to be accepted even though they should not be. The patches add checks to reject these requests for private nodes with an error code -EOPNOTSUPP.
